description:
This policy setting allows you to specify what URL to send users to when the More Actions button is clicked.  The More Actions button can be found under File tab | Options | Proofing | Autocorrect Options... | Actions | More Actions.

If you enable this policy setting and you specify a URL, the More Actions button will send the user to the specified URL.  If you enable this policy setting and you do not specify a URL (you leave the field blank), the More Actions button is disabled.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the More Actions button will send the user to the default URL.
